name: The Tome of Divinity

angles.text: This task marks a crucial milestone in a paladin's training in Stormwind, testing whether an initiate possesses the spiritual strength to wield the Symbol of Life.
Defias activity near Heroes' Vigil poses a continuous threat to travelers and citizens within Elwynn Forest, requiring the church's intervention.

faq.answer: Gazin Tenorm is an associate of Duthorian Rall who barely escaped an ambush by Defias bandits near Heroes' Vigil in Elwynn Forest. Severely injured during the encounter, he was brought into the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind to be treated by local priests.

aliases: what does symbol of life do
faq.answer: The Symbol of Life is a holy relic entrusted to paladin initiates deemed charitable and patient. It serves to test whether a rising champion has the spiritual focus and fortitude required to channel one of the Holy Light's greatest gifts—the restoration of life.
faq.q: What is the Symbol of Life?

faq.answer: Heroes' Vigil is an area in Elwynn Forest where Gazin Tenorm and his companion Henze were ambushed by Defias outlaws. While Gazin managed to flee back to Stormwind with grievous wounds, the fate of his friend Henze demands aid.

Henze is Gazin Tenorm's companion who was present when Defias bandits attacked them in Elwynn Forest near Heroes' Vigil. While Gazin made it back to Stormwind alive, Henze was left behind in the field.

The quest giver is Duthorian Rall, a leader among the paladins in the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind. After confirming an initiate has proven their patience and charity, he directs them to speak with Gazin Tenorm at the altar.
faq.q: Who sends you to speak with Gazin Tenorm?

aliases: why are defias near heroes vigil
faq.answer: The Defias Brotherhood has spread outlaws and highwaymen across Elwynn Forest, ambushing travelers even within striking distance of the capital. Gazin Tenorm's harrowing encounter demonstrates how brazen and lethal Defias operations have become.
faq.q: Why are Defias bandits attacking travelers near Heroes' Vigil?

sections.body: In the Cathedral of Light, paladin initiates who have shown patience and charity receive the Symbol of Life. Entrusted by Duthorian Rall, this holy vessel serves as a test to determine whether an aspiring champion possesses sufficient spiritual devotion to focus one of the Light's greatest gifts: the power to restore life to the fallen.
sections.title: A Test of Devotion

sections.body: The urgent need for the Symbol is made clear by Gazin Tenorm, who recently crawled back to Stormwind after a vicious assault by Defias bandits near Heroes' Vigil in Elwynn Forest. While priests at the cathedral altar tend to Gazin's severe wounds, his companion Henze remains in peril where the outlaws struck.
sections.title: Ambush at Heroes' Vigil

summary: The Tome of Divinity represents an essential trial for paladin initiates within Stormwind's Cathedral of Light, charging them with focusing the holy Symbol of Life. After proving their virtue, aspirants are directed to assist Gazin Tenorm, who barely escaped a deadly Defias ambush near Heroes' Vigil in Elwynn Forest.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Tome of Divinity
